scope: Explicit in-place Files v4 repair at existing limits, reusing bounded compatibility Snapshot preparation and existing publication
keyPolicy: Preview performs reader(false) only; exact missing-key is distinct from inaccessible Keychain errors. Confirmed repair rechecks original observation before atomic create-absent SecItemAdd (no read/return-existing); duplicate alias refuses. Newly created owned key is retained on later failure; unreadable predecessor files remain unchanged and fresh explicit retry is proven. No foreign-key adoption/removal or full key-state rollback claim.
sourcePolicy: Pinned actual root, raw pointer digest and original encrypted root/receipt inventory (identity/type/owner/mode/size/timestamps/SHA256). Incremental64KiB hashing; unknown regular entries are bound, unsafe links/deeper directory trees or files above existing32MiB read bound refuse. Recheck before preview return, install/provision and prepublication; only exact owned new names and validated managed rollback copy excluded after staging.
faultScope: Injected prepublication/verified/journal-cleared errors and actual Task cancellation at committed checkpoint; original fixture files unchanged after every failed install. No real disk-full, power loss, physical-device Keychain or protection test.
limitations: Repair-only full Snapshot hydration remains within existing capacity; normal healthy v4 candidate and live-state paths remain receipt-free.

Raw inventory capture/preview recheck is synchronous on current store actor; bulk v4 decode and confirmation preparation/publication run on ArchiveWorker. Metadata history may make inventory expensive; no performance claim.

Existing publication may retain unactivated encrypted metadata or quarantined receipt files after failed writes. No unrelated cleanup, cap/format/cloud change, a11y sweep, metadata-GC implementation or release claim.
tokenEstimate: Approximately18k-20k including required raw-inventory and atomic-key-creation review corrections; estimate, not tool-metered.

previousRuns.limitation: Did not cover creation-boundary arrival. Independent review found generic create-or-load could adopt a key arriving after missing observation; fixed before final run.

platformKeychainProof: On owned simulator only: existing alias loaded, actual DeviceKey.createAbsent SecItemAdd duplicate refused, existing key unchanged. Missing-to-foreign arrival inside creator is separately injected; physical device not run.
